rule: A blocker only ever leaves this register when real, external, signed evidence closes it through pkg/governance/qualification. No blocker's qualification_status may be edited by hand to make this register look better than the manifest it is generated from.
living_register_note: Per the Round 7 work order's §XIX: this register is a source-of-truth, not a one-time report. Every field it carries is either mechanically derived from READINESS_MANIFEST.json (engineering_status, qualification_status, qualification_level, blocking_production) or a stable, hand-authored requirement description that changes only when the blocker's own real-world requirements change -- never to inflate a status.

blockers.infrastructure_requirement: A reachable staging/production-equivalent deployment for the vendor to test against; none exists in this sandbox.
blockers.security_requirement: Signed vendor report through pkg/governance/qualification's registered-reviewer-identity + release-bound-signature + live-revocation-check pipeline.
blockers.operational_requirement: Remediation-and-retest cycle after the vendor's initial report.
blockers.external_evidence_required: A reachable staging/production-equivalent deployment for the vendor to test against; none exists in this sandbox.
blockers.acceptance_criteria: A named, credentialed penetration-testing vendor delivers a signed report against a real deployment of this exact release, findings are remediated, and a retest confirms closure.
blockers.owner: Repository owner / security team: engage and fund an external pentest vendor.

blockers.external_evidence_required: A procured HSM/KMS tenancy (e.g. a real AWS KMS account with valid credentials, or an on-prem HSM).
blockers.acceptance_criteria: A real HSM/KMS tenancy is procured, VERIQO's adapter is integration-tested against it end-to-end (generate/sign/verify/rotate/revoke/recover), and the evidence is captured.

blockers.description: 72-hour continuous soak test under sustained workload, measuring memory/goroutine/connection/queue/disk growth, CPU saturation, database degradation, and recovery from injected failures.
blockers.code_requirement: test/soak + pkg/blockers/soak: Start/Checkpoint/Monitor/DetectLeak/DetectDrift/Finalize/GenerateEvidence API with a hash-chained, tamper-evident checkpoint sequence.
blockers.infrastructure_requirement: A long-lived host that can stay up for 72 continuous hours -- this sandboxed session's container is reclaimed on inactivity and cannot honestly provide this.
blockers.security_requirement: Tamper-evident checkpoint chain so a partial or interrupted run cannot be silently passed off as a full one.
blockers.operational_requirement: p50/p95/p99, error rate, throughput, recovery time, data loss, duplicate processing, and replay divergence measurement across the full window.
blockers.external_evidence_required: A long-lived host that can stay up for 72 continuous hours -- this sandboxed session's container is reclaimed on inactivity and cannot honestly provide this.
blockers.acceptance_criteria: VERIQO_SOAK_MINUTES=4320 (72h) against the same unchanged test suite, run on a long-lived host, completes with zero errors and the full metric set captured as immutable evidence.
blockers.owner: Repository owner / SRE: run the existing, unmodified soak harness on a long-lived host for the full 72-hour window.
blockers.next_action: Run VERIQO_SOAK_MINUTES=4320 against the existing soak harness on infrastructure that can stay up 72 continuous hours.

blockers.description: Multi-region disaster recovery: primary-region loss, consensus-node failure, network partition, storage/DNS/credential/KMS outage, measured RPO/RTO with acknowledged-write and ordering preservation.
blockers.code_requirement: pkg/blockers/dr models regions as real raftlite nodes over a real network-partition-capable transport; measures real RTO/RPO, heals, confirms convergence.
blockers.infrastructure_requirement: Real distinct multi-host/multi-datacenter/cloud-region infrastructure -- this round's own drill ran 3 real Docker containers, but all on one physical host, which is not a real cross-region test.
blockers.security_requirement: Credential and KMS outage handling proven under partition, not just node loss.
blockers.operational_requirement: State before failure vs. state after recovery must be deterministically reconstructable and verifiable.
blockers.external_evidence_required: Real distinct multi-host/multi-datacenter/cloud-region infrastructure -- this round's own drill ran 3 real Docker containers, but all on one physical host, which is not a real cross-region test.
blockers.acceptance_criteria: The same drill (leader partition, RTO/RPO measurement, heal, converge) is re-run across real distinct cloud regions or datacenters, not single-host containers.
blockers.owner: Repository owner: procure real multi-region cloud infrastructure and re-run the existing DR drill against it.
blockers.next_action: Procure real multi-region infrastructure; re-run cmd/veriqo-node's existing DR drill across real regions.
